summary: One catalog entry per open pane is either Running(process/runtime identity) or Unavailable(Pi pane metadata/recovery state). Recovery moves Idle to InProgress(unique RuntimeId), then commits to Running only if the same session/pane reservation is current; failure releases it, while close/shutdown/removal invalidates stale work. Session queries include running and unavailable panes exactly once.
lifetime: Runtime pane state is rebuilt from durable open session/shell rows at daemon startup. Runtime IDs and recovery reservations are process-local; persisted Pi identity/transcript references survive restart.
